passages.text: Then the whole congregation of Israel left the Desert of Sin, moving from place to place as the LORD commanded. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were a large group of people.
They left the Desert of Sin together.
They traveled from place to place.
The LORD told them where to go.
They camped at a place called Rephidim.
There was no water for the people to drink at Rephidim.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּסְעוּ כָּל־ עֲדַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל מִמִּדְבַּר־ סִ֛ין לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בִּרְפִידִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין מַ֖יִם לִשְׁתֹּ֥ת הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: So the people contended with Moses, “Give us water to drink.” “Why do you contend with me?” Moses replied. “Why do you test the LORD?”
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel argued with Moses.
They said, “Give us water to drink.”
Moses replied to the people.
He said, “Why do you argue with me?”
He said, “Why do you test the LORD?”
passages.original: וַיָּ֤רֶב הָעָם֙ עִם־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ תְּנוּ־ לָ֥נוּ מַ֖יִם וְנִשְׁתֶּ֑ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה מַה־ תְּרִיבוּן֙ עִמָּדִ֔י מַה־ תְּנַסּ֖וּן אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: But the people thirsted for water there, and they grumbled against Moses: “Why have you brought us out of Egypt—to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?”
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel camped at Rephidim.
There was no water for them to drink.
The people became very thirsty.
They complained to Moses.
They said to Moses, “Why did you bring us out of Egypt?”
They asked, “Did you bring us here to die of thirst?”
They said, “You will kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst.”
passages.original: וַיִּצְמָ֨א שָׁ֤ם הָעָם֙ לַמַּ֔יִם וַיָּ֥לֶן הָעָ֖ם עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לָ֤מָּה זֶּה֙ הֶעֱלִיתָ֣נוּ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם לְהָמִ֥ית אֹתִ֛י וְאֶת־ בָּנַ֥י וְאֶת־ מִקְנַ֖י בַּצָּמָֽא׃

passages.text: Then Moses cried out to the LORD, “What should I do with these people? A little more and they will stone me!”
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The Israelites were angry and thirsty.
Moses cried out to the LORD.
He said, “What should I do with these people?”
He said, “Soon they will stone me.”
passages.original: וַיִּצְעַ֤ק מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה ע֥וֹד מְעַ֖ט וּסְקָלֻֽנִי׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Walk on ahead of the people and take some of the elders of Israel with you. Take along in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
The LORD told Moses to walk ahead of the people.
The LORD told Moses to take some elders of Israel with him.
The LORD told Moses to take his staff in his hand.
Moses had used this staff to strike the Nile.
The LORD told Moses to go.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה עֲבֹר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם וְקַ֥ח אִתְּךָ֖ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמַטְּךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכִּ֤יתָ בּוֹ֙ אֶת־ הַיְאֹ֔ר קַ֥ח בְּיָדְךָ֖ וְהָלָֽכְתָּ׃

passages.text: Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.” So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God said, “I will stand before you.
I will stand by the rock at Horeb.
You must strike the rock.
Water will come out of the rock.
The people will drink the water.”
Moses obeyed God.
Moses struck the rock.
The elders of Israel watched Moses do this.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֣י עֹמֵד֩ לְפָנֶ֨יךָ שָּׁ֥ם׀ עַֽל־ הַצּוּר֮ בְּחֹרֵב֒ וְהִכִּ֣יתָ בַצּ֗וּר וְיָצְא֥וּ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ מַ֖יִם וְשָׁתָ֣ה הָעָ֑ם וַיַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: He named the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us or not?”
passages.sermon:
Moses gave the place a name.
He called it Massah and Meribah.
The Israelites argued at this place.
They tested the LORD there.
They said, “Is the LORD with us or not?”
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָא֙ שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֔וֹם מַסָּ֖ה וּמְרִיבָ֑ה עַל־ רִ֣יב׀ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְעַ֨ל נַסֹּתָ֤ם אֶת־ יְהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֲיֵ֧שׁ יְהוָ֛ה בְּקִרְבֵּ֖נוּ אִם־ אָֽיִן׃פ

passages.text: After this, the Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.
passages.sermon: The Amalekites were a hostile people.\r\nThey came to the place called Rephidim.\r\nThey attacked the Israelites there.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֖א עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַיִּלָּ֥חֶם עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּרְפִידִֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses said to Joshua, “Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on the hilltop with the staff of God in my hand.”
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Joshua was his assistant.
The Amalekites attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.
Moses spoke to Joshua.
Moses said, “Choose some men from among us.”
Moses told Joshua, “Go out and fight the Amalekites.”
Moses said, “Tomorrow I will stand on top of the hill.”
Moses said, “I will hold the staff of God in my hand.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ בְּחַר־ לָ֣נוּ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְצֵ֖א הִלָּחֵ֣ם בַּעֲמָלֵ֑ק מָחָ֗ר אָנֹכִ֤י נִצָּב֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַגִּבְעָ֔ה וּמַטֵּ֥ה הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּיָדִֽי׃

passages.text: Joshua did as Moses had instructed him and fought against the Amalekites, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was an Israelite leader.
Moses was the prophet who led Israel.
Aaron and Hur were with Moses.
Moses told Joshua to fight the Amalekites.
Joshua obeyed Moses.
Joshua fought the Amalekites.
Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽמַר־ לוֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם בַּעֲמָלֵ֑ק וּמֹשֶׁה֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וְח֔וּר עָל֖וּ רֹ֥אשׁ הַגִּבְעָֽה׃

passages.text: As long as Moses held up his hands, Israel prevailed; but when he lowered them, Amalek prevailed.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Israel was fighting against the Amalekites.
When Moses raised his hands, Israel became stronger in the battle.
When Moses lowered his hands, the Amalekites became stronger.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥ים מֹשֶׁ֛ה יָד֖וֹ וְגָבַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנִ֛יחַ יָד֖וֹ וְגָבַ֥ר עֲמָלֵֽק׃

passages.text: When Moses’ hands grew heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Then Aaron and Hur held his hands up, one on each side, so that his hands remained steady until the sun went down.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses’ hands became heavy.
The people took a stone.
They put the stone under Moses.
Moses sat on the stone.
Aaron and Hur were with Moses.
Aaron stood on one side of Moses.
Hur stood on the other side of Moses.
Aaron and Hur held up Moses’ hands.
They supported his hands, one on each side.
Moses’ hands stayed steady.
His hands remained steady until the sun went down.
passages.original: וִידֵ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ כְּבֵדִ֔ים וַיִּקְחוּ־ אֶ֛בֶן וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ תַחְתָּ֖יו וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב עָלֶ֑יהָ וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן וְח֜וּר תָּֽמְכ֣וּ בְיָדָ֗יו מִזֶּ֤ה אֶחָד֙ וּמִזֶּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד וַיְהִ֥י יָדָ֛יו אֱמוּנָ֖ה עַד־ בֹּ֥א הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

passages.text: So Joshua overwhelmed Amalek and his army with the sword.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel’s army.
Joshua fought against Amalek and his army.
Joshua defeated Amalek and his army with the sword.
Joshua overcame them in battle.
passages.original: וַיַּחֲלֹ֧שׁ יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֥ק וְאֶת־ עַמּ֖וֹ לְפִי־ חָֽרֶב׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Write this on a scroll as a reminder and recite it to Joshua, because I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to write something down.
The LORD told Moses to write this as a reminder in a book.
The LORD told Moses to speak these words to Joshua.
The LORD said He will completely erase the memory of Amalek.
The LORD said He will remove Amalek’s memory from under heaven.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה כְּתֹ֨ב זֹ֤את זִכָּרוֹן֙ בַּסֵּ֔פֶר וְשִׂ֖ים בְּאָזְנֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כִּֽי־ מָחֹ֤ה אֶמְחֶה֙ אֶת־ זֵ֣כֶר עֲמָלֵ֔ק מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: And Moses built an altar and named it The LORD Is My Banner.
passages.sermon: Moses was the leader of Israel.\r\nMoses built an altar.\r\nMoses named the altar “The LORD Is My Banner.”
passages.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן מֹשֶׁ֖ה מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יְהוָ֥ה׀ נִסִּֽי׃

passages.text: “Indeed,” he said, “a hand was lifted up toward the throne of the LORD. The LORD will war against Amalek from generation to generation.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke about the LORD.
He said, “A hand was lifted up toward the throne of the LORD.”
The LORD will fight against Amalek.
The LORD will do this in every generation.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־ יָד֙ עַל־ כֵּ֣ס יָ֔הּ מִלְחָמָ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה בַּֽעֲמָלֵ֑ק מִדֹּ֖ר דֹּֽר׃פ
